note: Shared cases pinning the TWO HTML-document scanners to each other (spec: reports). The renderer supplies a document's ordinal; the backend resolves it. Divergence means the user saves a document other than the one they clicked, and nothing in the result says so. `src/features/chat/richContent/detect.test.ts` and `src-tauri/src/reports/tests.rs` both read THIS file, so a case added for one is enforced on the other. Rust reaches into the frontend tree here the same way `crates/contracts/tests/contract_snapshots.rs` reaches into `src/lib/generated/contracts.ts`.
